title: Degent submission rules
description: Metadata of a submission that complies with the published degent.club Minting Rules (products/degent/docs/site-spec.md, 'Mint process'). Provided by @bsh/degent-mint-sdk (src/degent-rules.ts, DEGENT_RULES) and enforced by the studio at PUT /v1/artworks/{id}/content; the mint re-checks the same bytes. Rules a schema cannot express (the picture itself, width == height) are listed under x-vision and x-constraints and are checked by code, a vision model or a human.

contentType.description: Real type from the magic bytes, never the declared one. JPEG is recommended; the others are accepted.

bytes.description: Exact content length. The range picks the tier (ADR-0005 §3).

width.description: Pixels, read from the image header.

x-constraints.statement: no per-wallet cap: any number of submissions per artist

x-vision.statement: Pepe character wearing a tuxedo with a mandatory bowtie.
Must be framed and include a placard that says "DEGEN", "DEGENT", or "REGEN".
